t: PURPA Qualifying Facilities | Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
s: QFs have the right to sell energy and capacity to a utility (see 18 C.F.R. § 304), provided the purchasing utility has not been relieved from its QF purchase obligation (see 18 C.F.R. § 309-311). With limited exceptions, QFs generally have the option of selling to a utility either at the utility's avoided cost or at a negotiated rate.
